encryption.ciphertext: base64url without padding; redacted maestro-session-export.v1 JSON plus GCM tag

signature.payload: canonical JSON of the envelope with signer.signature omitted

keys.encryptionKeyFile: exactly 32 raw bytes; local file must not be group- or world-readable on Unix; shared out of band with the intended recipient
keys.signingKeyFile: Ed25519 PKCS#8 private key; local file must not be group- or world-readable
keys.custody: Maestro does not generate, persist, upload, or escrow operator keys

redaction.policy: credential redaction is mandatory before secure serialization and encryption
redaction.rawCredentials: never included in a secure bundle

replay.importMarker: portableBundleId is written into each imported session header
replay.policy: replaying a verified bundle is safe and creates collision-resistant new session IDs; no tools execute during import

compatibility.legacyV1: existing json and jsonl imports remain supported without keys
compatibility.secureV1: secure envelopes are never downgraded to plaintext imports
